change: Retain native muted MP4 playback, remove pre-playing video visibility suppression, and cover paused or blocked video with an authenticated animation of the same loop. The animation has no media playback controls or audio.
limits: Real iPhone Safari was not available. Chromium was launched with --mute-audio. Permanent background video rejection was simulated; animation movement was verified by changing screenshot pixels against a stable static-image control. No native fullscreen was invoked.
sharedFinding: The current Events gate creates a new iframe and video after awaiting password authentication; the original entry gesture is not retained. The directory task is investigating a persistent video started synchronously in the entry action. This release makes the Events background animation independent of video autoplay permission.
